label: Debt to equity
short_definition: Total debt relative to stockholders' equity.
perimeter: D2026-11-04.5 total debt incl. finance leases

label: Current ratio
short_definition: Current assets relative to current liabilities.

label: Interest coverage
short_definition: Operating income relative to interest expense.

label: Quick ratio
short_definition: Current assets excluding inventory relative to current liabilities.
notes: inventory absent counts as zero only where the filing does not present the line (quick_ratio_evidence rule); calculate.py ZERO_WHEN_ABSENT_CONCEPTS.

label: Net debt / EBITDA
short_definition: Debt less cash relative to trailing EBITDA.
formula_description: (Total Debt - Cash & Equivalents) / EBITDA (TTM). Computed in expanded_metrics.py -- EBITDA lives in metric_value, not canonical_fact, so calculate.py's generic engine can't reach it.
perimeter: D2026-11-04.5 total debt incl. finance leases
notes: expanded_metrics.py takes the LATEST instant total_debt/cash, not the instant at the TTM window end. Drift D5.

label: Zero debt
short_definition: Binary flag: 1 when reported total debt is zero; otherwise 0.
formula_description: 1 if total_debt == 0 for the fiscal year, else 0; null (not 0) if total_debt wasn't reported at all that year -- absence is not evidence of debt-free status. Computed in mapper/quality_flags.py, per FY year.
perimeter: D2026-11-04.5 total debt incl. finance leases

label: Net cash
short_definition: Cash and equivalents less total debt.
perimeter: D2026-11-04.5 total debt incl. finance leases

label: Net cash per share
short_definition: Net cash divided by shares outstanding.
perimeter: D2026-11-04.5 total debt incl. finance leases

label: Book value per share
short_definition: Stockholders' equity divided by shares outstanding.

label: Debt / EBITDA
short_definition: Total debt relative to trailing twelve-month EBITDA.
formula_description: Total Debt / EBITDA (TTM) -- gross leverage, distinct from net_debt_ebitda (which nets out Cash & Equivalents first). Computed in expanded_metrics.py.
perimeter: D2026-11-04.5 total debt incl. finance leases
